fields.title: UMUCYO Rwanda tender notice record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _mode/_source/_scrapedAt (plus _error/_errorDetail on failures, or _warning on partial results). 'list' records carry listing fields (and, if fetchDetails was on, the enriched detail_page_heading/fields/attachments/raw_text); 'detail' records carry only the enriched detail fields for the requested detail_ref(s).

_mode.title: Mode
_mode.description: Which run mode produced this record: list or detail.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-advertising-list-gu (listing row, mode=list), S1-advertising-detail-page (direct detail-mode fetch), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed fetches -- invalid_detail_ref or blocked_or_transient.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

tender_name.title: Tender name
tender_name.description: The tender's title as shown in the listing (mode=list).

tender_no.title: Tender number (display)
tender_no.description: The human-readable tender reference shown in the listing table, e.g. "000001/NC/NCB/2026/2027/R-CAMD" -- ends in the procuring entity's abbreviation, NOT the same string needed to fetch the detail page (see tend_refer_no).

tend_refer_no.title: Tender reference (internal)
tend_refer_no.description: The internal reference used to fetch this tender's detail page, e.g. "000001/NC/NCB/2026/2027/1207000001" -- ends in the procuring entity's internal numeric code, parsed from the listing row's own hidden form value.

tend_stage_cd.title: Stage code
tend_stage_cd.description: Internal tender-stage code (values seen: O, F -- undocumented upstream, passed through opaquely), required alongside tend_refer_no and tend_type_cd to fetch the detail page.

tend_mthod_cd.title: Method code
tend_mthod_cd.description: Procurement method code: NCB (National Competitive Bidding) or ICB (International Competitive Bidding).

tend_type_cd.title: Type code
tend_type_cd.description: Procurement type code: G (Goods), C (Consultant Services), NC (Non Consultant Services), or W (Works).

status_cd.title: Status code
status_cd.description: Internal one-letter advertisement status code (e.g. P for Published), parsed from the listing row's hidden form value -- a different taxonomy from the tenderStatus filter's ADV/OPE/EVA/SIG/CAN/A codes.

status.title: Status
status.description: Human-readable status as shown in the listing's Status column, e.g. "Published".

advertising_date.title: Advertising date
advertising_date.description: Date this tender was advertised, format dd/MM/yyyy.

deadline_of_submitting.title: Submission deadline
deadline_of_submitting.description: Bid/proposal submission deadline, format dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm.

planned_open_date.title: Planned bid opening date
planned_open_date.description: Scheduled bid-opening date/time, format dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm.

detail_ref.title: Detail ref
detail_ref.description: Pass this exact string back as one of `detailRefs` in mode='detail' to re-fetch this tender's full detail directly. Format: "tend_refer_no|tend_stage_cd|tend_type_cd".

detail_page_heading.title: Detail page heading
detail_page_heading.description: The detail page's own heading, e.g. "View Details of One Stage Advertising (Services)" (present when fetchDetails is on, or in mode='detail').

fields.title: Detail fields
fields.description: Every upstream label/value pair from the tender's detail page (Tender No, Procurement Plan Name, Advertising/Procuring Entity, Tender Type, Tender Method, Brief Description, Deadline for Bids Submission, Opening Date, Tender Fee, Tender Security, Local preference, Margin of Preference, and more -- the exact set varies by tender type/stage), passed through with upstream's own labels as keys.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Downloadable tender-document metadata (file_id, file_name, document_name, upload_date) listed on the detail page. Actually downloading the files was not reverse-engineered (out of scope) -- only metadata is captured.

raw_text.title: Raw detail text
raw_text.description: The full visible text of the detail page's main content area, whitespace-normalized -- a fallback so nothing is lost for template variants (e.g. older "Request for Expressions of Interest" pages) whose key info is embedded as inline paragraph text rather than in the labeled fields table.

_detailError.title: Detail fetch error
_detailError.description: Present if fetchDetails was on but the per-notice detail page could not be fetched/parsed -- listing fields are still included.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: Set on partial results, e.g. if pagination stopped early after a transient error.
